items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: a fellow offered me a job with Billy Fowler's band... I don't know Billy. Billy was a helluva nice guy. He had heard about me, and he was glad that I could join the band.

ctx.x: The drummer...hmm, I must have knew who he was. And he had to be good to be down there. Because all these cats was what you called sharks, you know. All well-experienced men -- except me. I wonder how I even got in there. And Billy Fowler was a hell of a musician himself. He was a hell of a saxophone player.
